# Top Brands Syria

Top Brands Syria is a leading, fast-growing FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) distribution company in Syria. We specialize in both food and non-food products, exclusive brand representation, advanced logistics, and nationwide market coverage across all 14 Syrian governorates.

## Contact Information
- Email: info@topbrands-sy.com
- Phone: +963 11 6022
- Location: Damascus, Syria (Coordinates: 33.6193071287417, 36.489023297392414)
- Website: https://topbrands-sy.com

## Core Services
1. FMCG Distribution: End-to-end distribution from warehousing to retail shelves.
2. Advanced Logistics: Cold chain solutions, temperature-controlled warehousing, and GPS-enabled fleet.
3. Merchandising & Sales Execution: Professional sales force ensuring high brand visibility.
4. Market Coverage & Insights: Reaching over 15,000 retail partners across traditional and modern trade channels.
